name: frame-belts
conditions: M50 fix round 3. Tyler's Mac (Apple M3 Max, 14 logical CPUs), Playwright 1.63.0 channel 'chromium' (real Metal adapter, headless), --enable-unsafe-webgpu --disable-frame-rate-limit --disable-gpu-vsync, playwright.config.ts 'frame-bench' project with --workers 1, `pnpm test:slow frame-bench -t frame_belts`. Measure only at a 1-min load under 4 (`sysctl -n vm.loadavg`); at 4.4-5 the mid worker p50 read 1.962, 2.436, 2.735 (an earlier tree) and 1.982 ms. Page belts-bench.html (dev-profile fx-belts .wasm, opt-level 1, as every frame bench): fx-belts' SaturatedView { jam_pct 0, period 0 } at scale 1 (144 x 256 belt tiles, 2,974 lines, 294,912 items), caps maxLines 32,768 / maxItems 393,216, chunk pacing lifted, real-time sim pacing (test.flags pace, noOpfs), local host, connect, genWorkers 1, canvas 1280 x 720 at DPR 1, camera centre (128, 72), triangle-wave pan of +-8 tiles along x at 12 tiles/s (0.2 tile a frame), fixture item cut 20 px a tile. Scenes: zoomout = 256 across (36,864 belt sprites held, no item, 2,974 lines held); mid = 64 across, the item cut (2,829 belt sprites, 25,407-25,459 records held, 1,317-1,364 lines held). Each scene: join waited on (6.0 and 3.0 s), 120 warm-up + 300 timed rAF frames, marks mf-s/mf-e (main) and wf-s/wf-e (client-worker frame()). Thirteen quiet runs (fix round 1's ten at 1-min load 3.38-3.99 and fix round 2's three at 3.63-3.87; neither scene changed with the cut's move from 16 to 20 px), p50 ms: zoomout main 0.355-0.369, worker 0.914-1.762; mid main 0.259-0.279, worker 1.764-2.281 (sorted 1.764, 1.771, 1.784, 1.815, 1.827, 1.827, 1.848, 1.848, 1.861, 2.003, 2.167, 2.234, 2.281). This baseline is fix round 1's run 4 (1-min load 3.73), the upper median of fix round 1's ten runs (the 9th of all thirteen) of the mid worker (1.861); its figures are the run's printed ones (its record was not written: that run stopped at a pin of the since-removed 80-across scene, after the measurement). Its mid main p95 1.428 is a hitch (other runs 0.50-1.29; not gated). Flake risks at quiet load, stated: the mid worker's gate line is 1.861 x 1.25 = 2.326, 0.045 above the quiet maximum 2.281; the zoomout worker is bimodal (0.914-0.966 in 3 of 13, 1.240-1.474 in 9) with a tail run at 1.762, 39 % over this baseline's 1.267 (line 1.584): 1 of 13 quiet runs fails zoomout. Not diagnosed: the mode is fixed for a run and the low/high ratio is about 1.35, consistent with the client worker landing on efficiency or performance cores. The zoomout worker is in effect gated against its upper mode, above about 1.58 ms. minDeltaMs 0.04 (ADR 0047): twice the largest thirteen-run spread of the sub-millisecond gated metrics (mid main 0.279 - 0.259 = 0.020); the worker metrics are over a millisecond, where 0047 puts the floor at 0, and 0.04 is below their 25 %. limits are the 0018 section 9 desktop proxies (main 1.3, worker 2.7 ms). The cut is 20 px because at 80 across (16 px, 4,250 belt tiles, about 34,000 items, 38,156-38,254 records) the worker p50 read 2.159-3.314 ms over ten quiet runs, over 2.7 in three. engine_mem_grows 0 in both workers and dropped 0 in every run.
